messages:
aoife: Heads-up: runtime merged change that flips default batching to 'aggressive' and adds a new quant profile. Need a short relnote, migration steps, and SDK snippet updates (py + js). tagging @rachel @samir.
rachel: On it. Can someone paste the concise user-facing bullets I should call out? I can draft the blurb and snippets after that.
samir: From runtime: 1) default `batching.policy` = "aggressive" (better throughput for long sequences) 2) new quant profile `q8-dynmix` available on x86-gpu images 3) legacy profiles q4_0/q4_1 still supported but deprecated.
morgan: Caveat: small-sequence latency (sub-100 tokens) can increase ~10-20ms in low-concurrency setups. Add a Known Issue with opt-out instructions.
aoife: For snippets, update prior py example that did `client.generate(..., batching=None)` to show explicit opt-out with `batching.policy = "none"` and how to pin `quant_profile`.
rachel: Draft Python snippet for docs: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(
    model="redwood-1-small",
    prompt=prompt,
    config={"batching": {"policy": "none"}, "quant_profile": "q4_1"}
)
```
rachel: I'll add the JS snippet after we lock wording. Short relnote draft: "Default batching set to 'aggressive' to improve throughput for long-sequence workloads. If you rely on sub-100-token latency, you may see slightly higher tail latency; to restore prior behavior set `batching.policy: 'none'` in your client config or pin a per-route override in Console."
samir: Migration doc additions: Console/global opt-out steps, private-deploy CLI example, per-route override examples, and link to runtime kernel-selection note (/docs/runtime/kernel-selection). Please run link checks on that anchor.

aoife: Action items: Rachel -> update PR with py/js snippets and Known Issue blurb; Samir -> add migration CLI + private-deploy examples; Morgan -> ops rollout notes + Dedicated handbook mention; DocOps -> resolve docs#812 and re-run link-check. I'll merge relnote once snippets land and CI is green. :thumbsup:
